thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: GPU_OOM_Spike on pool 'p-west2a-3'
incident-bot: Alert rate: 18/min, unique hosts: 7, sample error: "CUDA out of memory when allocating 2.1 GiB"
incident-bot: Links: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD12345 , runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/gpu-oom
PagerDuty: Triggered by policy 'gpu-OOM-threshold-v2' (threshold=10/min over 5m)
Aisha (oncall): Acked. I'm looking. Which customers are impacted?
Tom H: seeing increased 5xxs in inference-proxy for a small set of customers: cust-arcsoft and cust-courier, average latency spikes ~300ms->1.2s
Ravi S: logs from worker-12 on p-west2a-3: ```2026-03-15T02:14:07Z ERROR cuda: alloc failed: out of memory, requested 2251799813685248 bytes```
Kelsey M: that's the weird double-sized allocation bug we've seen on 2.1.x kernels. Patch available in canary. Can we fallback to model-quantized-compat variant? :thinking_face:
Aisha (oncall): Initiating mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller-variant for pool p-west2a-3; 2) cordon + drain offending hosts; 3) trigger worker restart with smaller kvcache config. I'll update status.
eng-rotation-bot: Paging handoff scheduled: next on-call Tom H in 12m.
PagerDuty: Escalation: auto-escalate to level-2 after 10m (current ack by Aisha)
Tom H: On it. Aisha DM me the list of drained hosts so I can pick up if you need handoff.
Aisha (oncall): Draining hosts now: worker-12, worker-15, worker-19. Command used: `kubectl set env deployment/infer-worker KV_CACHE_SIZE=128Mi --namespace=prod-west2a`
Ravi S: Observed immediate drop in CUDA OOM logs on drained units but still some spiky OOMs on worker-21. Queue depth still high (~120 requests).
Kelsey M: I'm enabling model-variant fallback in the router: `PATCH /routes/inference` payload -> `{fallback_model: "gpt-lite-quant"}` (applied). Will watch for quality regressions.
Aisha (oncall): Noting customer impact: partial degradation for cust-arcsoft (some requests returned slower or fell back to smaller model) => SOC notified, support ticket created #SUP-4281
Tom H: Running targeted restart on worker-21: `systemctl restart infer-worker` -> monitoring logs.
Ravi S: After restart, worker-21 started with lower kv cache, no OOM seen for 6 minutes. Token throughput recovered to normal on that host.
PagerDuty: Alert rate reduced to 2/min, auto-suppress will fire if <3/min for 10m.
Aisha (oncall): Re-evaluating severity: moving to SEV2 (reduced blast radius, no full region outage). Documenting timeline in incident doc.
Kelsey M: We should flip on auto-shedder for p-west2a-3 until kernel patch deployed: `rdctl autoshedder enable --pool p-west2a-3 --threshold 80`
Aisha (oncall): Done. Dropping kv cache to 64Mi on restarted hosts as a precaution.
Tom H: I'll take handoff in 10m if this is still noisy. If noise persists after draining + autoshedder, plan is to failover traffic to p-west2b.
Ravi S: Quick note -- metrics show spike in prefetch traffic correlated with model variant that increased kvcache pressure. Adding a prefetched-eviction to mitigations.
Aisha (oncall): Confirming gateway routing did fallback for ~12% of requests for cust-arcsoft. Support sending heads-up now.
PagerDuty: Alert condition cleared at 1769130400 (rate fell below threshold).
Aisha (oncall): Observed stability for 10 minutes. Will keep watchers on for 30m. Logging steps and postmortem checklist: root-cause hypothesis -> kernel driver + certain model memory pattern causing overalloc; temporary mitigation -> fallback + autoshedder + drain; long-term -> kernel patch and canary rollout, add prefetched traffic guardrails.
Tom H: Taking formal handoff at 1769130500. I'll monitor for 1hr then close if green. Ping me in this thread for any regression. :thumbsup:
eng-rotation-bot: Handoff completed to Tom H
Aisha (oncall): Thanks everyone. Filing incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-0315-gpu-oom-spill
Ravi S: Post-check: memory histograms show 2 hosts with abnormal growth patterns; tagging for follow-up by infra-ml team.
Kelsey M: I'll prepare the canary build of kernel-2.1.3 with the allocation guard and a patch for kvcache sizing. ETA 48h.
Tom H: Closing note: customer impact contained, support notified, follow-ups assigned (infra-ml, runtime-kernel, routing). Will mark resolved after 1hr clean window.
incident-bot: Thread auto-archived after 60 minutes of inactivity."
